title: Lightly Fermented Greek Prawns Revithia
description: A traditional Greek dish featuring lightly fermented prawns in a pillowy revithia form, perfect for a solo dinner
instructions: Rinse the prawns under cold water and pat them dry with paper towels
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute
Add the prawns and cook until they are lightly browned
Add the chickpeas, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine
Add the water to the skillet and bring the mixture to a boil
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes
Remove the skillet from the heat and let it cool to room temperature
Cover the skillet with plastic wrap and refrigerate the mixture for at least 2 hours to allow it to ferment lightly
